description: Launcher capability: search, copy, hotkey, autostart. URL/file opens are Rust-only.
_comment_opener: No opener:* permission. The webview must NOT reach the opener plugin directly — its `open_url`/`allow-default-urls` would let pack content open http:/mailto:/tel: and bypass the https-only Rust gate (SEC-3/SEC-4). All opens route through the Rust `open_url` IPC and `tray.rs`, which call OpenerExt server-side (no capability needed).
